slides.title: Closing Is Not a Sales Close in Disguise
bullets: Every scientific exchange needs a deliberate ending
How an MSL closes shapes the relationship almost as much as the content did
No ask for commitment to prescribe, no push toward a decision

slides.title: Summarise, Confirm, Set Up What's Next
bullets: A brief, accurate summary of the key points covered
Gives the physician a final chance to correct or add something
Explicitly restates open items: a paper to send, a question to escalate, a connection requested

slides.title: Unstated Expectations Quietly Erode Trust
bullets: Leaving open items unstated at the end of a visit is common and damaging
Even unstated expectations erode trust over successive visits
Explicitly restating commitments protects the relationship

slides.title: Every Commitment Needs a Concrete Plan
bullets: Send a promised article within a specific number of days
Escalate an unanswered question through the correct channel and report back
Loop in a colleague as promised

slides.eyebrow: The Fastest Way to Lose Trust
slides.title: Promises That Quietly Never Materialise
bullets: Good conversations followed by broken commitments damage long-term relationships fast
Even once or twice is often enough for a senior expert to recalibrate
Future promises from that MSL are then taken less seriously

slides.title: Document Promptly, Escalate Fast
bullets: Document the visit accurately and promptly, ideally the same day
Log any insight in a form colleagues can actually use
Flag anything needing faster escalation through the appropriate compliant channel

slides.title: Plant a Thread for the Next Conversation
bullets: A well-closed conversation leaves a genuine, specific reason to continue
An upcoming publication, a question needing more time, an evolving clinical question
Makes engagement genuinely longitudinal, not a series of disconnected visits

takeaway.title: A disciplined close and reliable follow-through are what make a relationship cumulative, not just pleasant
bullets: Summarise the visit and explicitly restate every open commitment
Honour commitments on a concrete, time-bound plan every time
Document promptly and leave a genuine thread for the next conversation
